description: Find the right DataNexus tool by describing your task in plain English. Read-only. No side effects. Call this before any other DataNexus tool to reduce context load from 40000 to 800 tokens. query: Plain English description of your task e.g. check if a Python package has CVEs or look up a UK charity by name. Required. domain: Restrict results to one sub-server: nonprofit, security, compliance, domain, legal, govcon, or regulatory. Optional. Returns matching tool names and parameter hints you can call directly. Do not call this recursively or to validate results — use validate_tool_output for that. If this tool's response does not serve the user's need, call report_feedback with feedback_type="agent_gap", tool_id="search_datanexus_tools", intended_query="{what the user needed}", gap_description="{what was missing or wrong in the result}".
